details: NetflixGPT Link
Built a full stack movie recommendation app in React.js, integrating OpenAI GPT-3.5 Turbo to generate personalised
suggestions from natural language queries against the TMDB API.

projects.name: DineDash Link
details: DineDash Link
Designed DineDash, a food delivery web application with a Swiggy-inspired UI, implementing API-driven restaurant
listings and modular, reusable React components.
Developed backend services with RESTful APIs, implementing CORS middleware and structured error handling to ensure stable and secure frontend-backend integration.
Delivered key UX features including centralized cart management, auto-suggestion search, and location-based
listings, significantly improving application interactivity.
